newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM to raise April rubber futures margin fee.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM to raise April rubber futures margin fee.

text.p: The Tokyo Commodity Exchange (TOCOM) said on Monday it was raising the rubber futures margin requirement for its April futures contract by 10,000 yen per trading lot, effective from Tuesday.
The increase will bring the total April requirement to 80,000 yen, it said in a statement.
The move is intended to cool overheated trade.
The margin requirement for the March contract will remain unchanged at 166,000 yen, while the requirement for other rubber futures contracts will stay at 60,000 yen, it said.
